name: TC-48: Verify payment page UI elements are displayed correctly
description: Verify title, amount, currency, express pay buttons, card form fields and submit button.
descriptionHtml: Verify title, amount, currency, express pay buttons, card form fields and submit button.

testStage.description: Verify title, amount, currency, express pay buttons, card form fields and submit button.

steps.name: Check if title is displayed on WayForPay header
Get merchant title text from WayForPay header
Check if amount field is displayed
Get currently selected currency in WayForPay
Check if Apple Pay button is displayed
Check if Google Pay button is displayed
Check if payment methods dropdown is displayed
Check if card number field is displayed
Check if validity date field is displayed
Check if CVV field is displayed
Check if cardholder name field is displayed
Check if phone field is displayed
Check if email field is displayed
Verify "Оплатити" button is visible and enabled after filling required data
Fill complete payment form in WayForPay
Check if submit button is displayed
Check if submit button is enabled
